# Camera Controls

Source: [wiki article 2103](../archive/2103.md); edited 2024-02-19.

<a id="wiki-2103-n1"></a>

- Documented free-camera motion recipe chases a player Camera variable; horizontal throttle is transformed to world rotation, jump/crouch contributes vertical movement, and forward/backward follows full facing direction.

<a id="wiki-2103-n2"></a>

- Jump and crouch together cancel the vertical component; chase rate is 12 times a conditional capped throttle magnitude and reevaluates destination/rate.

<a id="wiki-2103-n3"></a>

- Collision variant raycasts from current camera position toward the intended step and offsets the result backward by 0.250; example includes environment collisions but excludes objects, barriers and other players by its filters.

<a id="wiki-2103-n4"></a>

- Author suggests extending collision by changing raycast object flag and included-player set.
